statement:
∀ (m : ℕ),
  0 ≤ (-1) ^ m * (log 2 - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (-1) ^ k / (↑k + 1)) ∧
    |∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (-1) ^ k / (↑k + 1) - log 2| < 1 / (↑m + 1)

goal.text:
